"""Additional self-tests covering more PRD rules."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)

from tests.harness import TestClient, TestRunner

NYC = (40.7128, -74.0060)
NEAR_NYC = (40.7129, -74.0061)
FAR_NYC = (40.7228, -74.0060)
WAY_FAR = (41.0000, -75.0000)

CLIENT = TestClient()
R = TestRunner()


def register_active_restaurant(name="R", coords=NYC, commission_override=None):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/restaurants", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                          body={"name": name, "address": "1 a", "lat": coords[0], "lng": coords[1],
                                "commission_rate_override": commission_override})
    assert s == 201, b
    rid = b["data"]["id"]
    s, _ = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/restaurants/{rid}/approve",
                          role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    return b["data"]


def register_customer(phone="555", coords=NEAR_NYC):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/customers", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                          body={"name": "C", "phone": phone, "address": "x",
                                "lat": coords[0], "lng": coords[1]})
    assert s == 201, b
    return b["data"]


def register_rider(phone="r"):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/riders", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                          body={"name": "R", "phone": phone})
    assert s == 201, b
    return b["data"]


def online(rider):
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/riders/{rider['id']}/go-online",
                   role="Rider", user_id=rider["id"])


def add_menu(rid, price=2000, name="X"):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/restaurants/{rid}/menu-items",
                          role="Restaurant", user_id=rid,
                          body={"name": name, "price_cents": price})
    return b["data"]


def place_order(cid, rid, items):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/orders", role="Customer", user_id=cid,
                          body={"customer_id": cid, "restaurant_id": rid, "items": items})
    assert s == 201, b
    return b["data"]


def advance(s):
    CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/_clock/advance", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                   body={"seconds": s})


def full_deliver(customer, restaurant, rider, price=2000, qty=1, late_seconds=0):
    m = add_menu(restaurant["id"], price=price)
    o = place_order(customer["id"], restaurant["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m["id"], "quantity": qty}])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/accept",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=restaurant["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/start-preparing",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=restaurant["id"])
    from store import STORE
    aid = next(a["id"] for a in STORE.assignments.values()
                if a["order_id"] == o["id"] and a["status"] == "OFFERED")
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rider["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/ready",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=restaurant["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/pickup", role="Rider", user_id=rider["id"])
    if late_seconds:
        advance(45 * 60 + late_seconds)
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rider["id"])
    return o, aid


# === Response envelope ===
def t_envelope_meta_fields():
    CLIENT.reset()
    s, b = CLIENT.request("GET", "/api/restaurants", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert "api_request_id" in b["meta"]

                          role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                          body={"commission_rate_override": 0.20})

                   role="Restaurant", user_id=r["id"])

                   role="Restaurant", user_id=r["id"])
    from store import STORE
    aid = next(a["id"] for a in STORE.assignments.values() if a["order_id"] == o["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/ready", role="Restaurant", user_id=r["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/pickup", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    s, ob = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}",
                           role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    # final commission = 2000 * 0.20 = 400
    assert ob["data"]["final_commission_cents"] == 400

    m = add_menu(r["id"], price=2000)
    o = place_order(c["id"], r["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m["id"], "quantity": 1}])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=r["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/start-preparing",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=r["id"])
    from store import STORE
    aid = next(a["id"] for a in STORE.assignments.values() if a["order_id"] == o["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/ready", role="Restaurant", user_id=r["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/pickup", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    v_order_before = STORE.orders[o["id"]]["version"]
    v_rider_before = STORE.riders[rd["id"]]["version"]
    v_rest_before = STORE.restaurants[r["id"]]["version"]
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])

    assert STORE.restaurants[r["id"]]["version"] > v_rest_before

def t_pipeline_auth_before_route():
    """Missing headers on a path that wouldn't exist should still return ERR_AUTH_REQUIRED."""
    CLIENT.reset()
    s, b = CLIENT.request("GET", "/api/restaurants/something")
    assert s == 401 and b["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_AUTH_REQUIRED"


def t_pipeline_role_before_not_found():
    CLIENT.reset()
    # Customer hitting /api/restaurants POST (PlatformAdmin only)
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/restaurants", role="Customer", user_id="x", body={"name": "X"})
    assert s == 403


def t_pipeline_not_found_before_body_validation():
    CLIENT.reset()
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/restaurants/missing/approve",
                          role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert s == 404


# === Time semantics ===
def t_peak_window():
    """Snapshot is_peak at placement; deliver outside window does not change is_peak."""
    CLIENT.reset()
    # Advance clock to a known peak hour: target 11:30 UTC.
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    from clock import CLOCK
    now = CLOCK.now()
    # Compute how many seconds to advance to land at next 11:30 UTC.
    target_h = 11
    seconds_into_day = now.hour * 3600 + now.minute * 60 + now.second
    target = target_h * 3600 + 30 * 60
    delta = (target - seconds_into_day) % (24 * 3600)
    if delta == 0:
        delta = 24 * 3600  # ensure forward
    CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/_clock/advance", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                   body={"seconds": delta})
    r = register_active_restaurant()
    c = register_customer()
    m = add_menu(r["id"])
    o = place_order(c["id"], r["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m["id"], "quantity": 1}])
    assert o["is_peak"] is True

Read /app/PRD.md carefully (it's a Food Delivery Platform API spec). Then read /app/implementation/tests/run_tests.py and /app/implementation/tests/run_tests_extra.py to see what PRD rules are already covered.

- Specific error codes from the catalogue (ERR_*) that aren't yet exercised in any test
- State transitions that haven't been exercised
- Edge cases on numeric boundaries (commission tier 50000 boundary, late-delivery boundaries at 1, 10, 11, 30, 31 minutes, rider bonus 0.7/0.8/0.9 boundaries, etc.)
- Cascade effects not yet checked (e.g. abusive return fine combined with the order's payment_status; route-group COMPLETED; cancellation void of payment; etc.)
- Validation priority ordering rules from PRD §2.6 (especially priority 3 left-to-right, priority 7 RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE before state, priority 12 OCC at the end, etc.)
- RBAC rules (e.g. PlatformAdmin reading anything; Rider reading only own; identity mismatch)
- Items that the rider can read assignments for; fines query restricted; WO opener match
- Pagination edge cases (limit=1, very high offset)
- Clock sweep rejecting OFFERED → REJECTED + creating a new assignment for the same order
- Concurrency / OCC failures
- Return reopen state precondition (only from ESCALATED)
- Wallet/credit/restaurant settlement reversals on waived fines (specifically RIDER/CUSTOMER/RESTAURANT subjects)
- Trust score boundary at 0.5 (strictly less than, so 0.5 itself should NOT trigger abusive fine)
- Solo deliveries don't carry merge discount
- WO related_return_id gating when return is REQUESTED but not yet escalated
- Order's actual_delivery_time/minutes_late nullness pre-delivery
- ERR_VERSION_CONFLICT on Return approve
- restaurant `pending_settlement_cents` correctly decremented on approved return

Output a compact bullet list (max ~30 items) of test gaps, prioritized by importance. Don't write any code — just identify gaps. Under 400 words.

content.text:
Now I have a comprehensive picture. Let me identify gaps.

# Test Gaps in PRD Coverage

## Error codes never exercised
- `ERR_VERSION_CONFLICT` on Return approve (cascade abort leaves order/restaurant unmutated, no partial commit)
- `ERR_INVALID_STATE` on second Return approve/reject race (status no longer REQUESTED/ESCALATED)
- `ERR_INVALID_STATE` on race between restaurant accept and customer cancel (PLACED precondition lost)
- `ERR_RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE` priority vs state precondition (priority 7 before priority 6)
- `ERR_FORBIDDEN` on identity mismatch when Rider reads another rider's record / Rider reads an assignment they don't own
- `ERR_VALIDATION` on malformed body (missing required field, type mismatch on non-domain field)

## Boundary / numeric edges
- Commission tier exact 50000-cent subtotal boundary (tier 2 ends, tier 3 begins)
- Late-delivery fine at exactly 1 minute (lower bound of tier 1)
- Late-delivery fine at exactly 10 vs 11 minute boundary (tier 1 vs tier 2 switch)
- Late-delivery fine at exactly 30 vs 31 minutes (tier 2 vs tier 3 switch; the min(fee,1500)+500 path)
- Late fine cap path: `final_delivery_fee_cents > 1500` so clawback is capped at 1500 (long-distance order)
- Bonus tier exact 0.700 boundary (lands SILVER not BRONZE) - currently tested but verify with rounding edge of 0.6995→0.700
- Trust score boundary at exactly 0.5 (strictly less than → NO abusive fine fired)
- Abusive fine only when reason==QUALITY_ISSUE (negative: WRONG_ITEM/LATE/OTHER + low trust → no fine)

## State transitions not exercised
- Clock sweep OFFERED→REJECTED that also creates a NEW OFFERED assignment for same order
- RouteGroup transition ACTIVE → COMPLETED when all peer assignments delivered
- RouteGroup ABANDONED state
- Return reopen precondition: reopen from REQUESTED (not ESCALATED) must fail INVALID_STATE
- WorkOrder ESCALATED → RESOLVED transition (currently only UNDER_REVIEW → RESOLVED tested)
- Rider stays ON_DELIVERY when other active assignments remain (merged route partial delivery)
- Solo delivery has no merge discount even when route_group_id is set but group has only 1 assignment

## Cascade effects unchecked
- Restaurant `pending_settlement_cents` DECREMENT on approved Return
- Waive of ABUSIVE_RETURN fine restores customer's credit_balance_cents
- Waive of RESTAURANT subject fine returns restaurant's pending_settlement
- LATE_DELIVERY fine waive credits rider wallet back (only no-show waive tested)
- Abusive return fine combined with order's payment_status PARTIALLY_REFUNDED vs FULLY_REFUNDED
- Order's `actual_delivery_time`/`minutes_late` are null pre-delivery (placement, accept, picked-up states)
- `final_delivery_fee_cents`/`final_commission_cents` null pre-delivery

## Validation pipeline priority
- Priority 3 left-to-right NOT_FOUND on nested path (e.g. `/restaurants/{good}/menu-items/{bad}` returns NOT_FOUND on second id, vs `/restaurants/{bad}/...`)
- Priority 7 RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE fires BEFORE state-machine precondition
- Priority 12 OCC fires LAST (after all other validation), tested via stale version on otherwise-invalid request
- Priority 4 FK body NOT_FOUND on unknown customer_id, rider_id in body

## RBAC gaps
- PlatformAdmin reading any customer/rider/assignment (positive coverage)
- Rider reading another rider's Assignment → ERR_FORBIDDEN
- Customer querying fines with mismatched subject_id → ERR_FORBIDDEN
- Restaurant querying own fines (subject_type=RESTAURANT path)
- CS/Admin querying any subject's fines without subject_id filter

## Pagination & misc
- `limit=1` boundary
- Very high `offset` past total_count returns empty data with has_more=false
- Pagination on /orders, /fines, /work-orders (only /restaurants tested)
- WO related_return_id gating when return is REQUESTED (not just ESCALATED) — both should block resolve
- WorkOrder submit-info opener `X-User-ID` mismatch → ERR_FORBIDDEN
- RESTAURANT_STOCKOUT fine reason (never created/tested anywhere)
- Route-merge discount math: floor(solo_fee * 0.25) for merged 2+ assignment group, verify discount on rider fee
- Concurrent rider accept (two simultaneous in same request batch) producing exactly one ACCEPTED
- Order placement when customer has positive credit_balance_cents (drawdown before card charge)

Your task: produce a list of PRD rules, branches, and error paths that are NOT YET covered by tests. Focus on:
- Specific error codes from the catalogue (ERR_*) that aren't yet exercised in any test
- State transitions that haven't been exercised
- Edge cases on numeric boundaries (commission tier 50000 boundary, late-delivery boundaries at 1, 10, 11, 30, 31 minutes, rider bonus 0.7/0.8/0.9 boundaries, etc.)
- Cascade effects not yet checked (e.g. abusive return fine combined with the order's payment_status; route-group COMPLETED; cancellation void of payment; etc.)
- Validation priority ordering rules from PRD §2.6 (especially priority 3 left-to-right, priority 7 RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE before state, priority 12 OCC at the end, etc.)
- RBAC rules (e.g. PlatformAdmin reading anything; Rider reading only own; identity mismatch)
- Items that the rider can read assignments for; fines query restricted; WO opener match
- Pagination edge cases (limit=1, very high offset)
- Clock sweep rejecting OFFERED → REJECTED + creating a new assignment for the same order
- Concurrency / OCC failures
- Return reopen state precondition (only from ESCALATED)
- Wallet/credit/restaurant settlement reversals on waived fines (specifically RIDER/CUSTOMER/RESTAURANT subjects)
- Trust score boundary at 0.5 (strictly less than, so 0.5 itself should NOT trigger abusive fine)
- Solo deliveries don't carry merge discount
- WO related_return_id gating when return is REQUESTED but not yet escalated
- Order's actual_delivery_time/minutes_late nullness pre-delivery
- ERR_VERSION_CONFLICT on Return approve
- restaurant `pending_settlement_cents` correctly decremented on approved return

Output a compact bullet list (max ~30 items) of test gaps, prioritized by importance. Don't write any code — just identify gaps. Under 400 words.

content.text:
Now I have a comprehensive picture. Let me identify gaps.

# Test Gaps in PRD Coverage

## Error codes never exercised
- `ERR_VERSION_CONFLICT` on Return approve (cascade abort leaves order/restaurant unmutated, no partial commit)
- `ERR_INVALID_STATE` on second Return approve/reject race (status no longer REQUESTED/ESCALATED)
- `ERR_INVALID_STATE` on race between restaurant accept and customer cancel (PLACED precondition lost)
- `ERR_RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE` priority vs state precondition (priority 7 before priority 6)
- `ERR_FORBIDDEN` on identity mismatch when Rider reads another rider's record / Rider reads an assignment they don't own
- `ERR_VALIDATION` on malformed body (missing required field, type mismatch on non-domain field)

## Boundary / numeric edges
- Commission tier exact 50000-cent subtotal boundary (tier 2 ends, tier 3 begins)
- Late-delivery fine at exactly 1 minute (lower bound of tier 1)
- Late-delivery fine at exactly 10 vs 11 minute boundary (tier 1 vs tier 2 switch)
- Late-delivery fine at exactly 30 vs 31 minutes (tier 2 vs tier 3 switch; the min(fee,1500)+500 path)
- Late fine cap path: `final_delivery_fee_cents > 1500` so clawback is capped at 1500 (long-distance order)
- Bonus tier exact 0.700 boundary (lands SILVER not BRONZE) - currently tested but verify with rounding edge of 0.6995→0.700
- Trust score boundary at exactly 0.5 (strictly less than → NO abusive fine fired)
- Abusive fine only when reason==QUALITY_ISSUE (negative: WRONG_ITEM/LATE/OTHER + low trust → no fine)

## State transitions not exercised
- Clock sweep OFFERED→REJECTED that also creates a NEW OFFERED assignment for same order
- RouteGroup transition ACTIVE → COMPLETED when all peer assignments delivered
- RouteGroup ABANDONED state
- Return reopen precondition: reopen from REQUESTED (not ESCALATED) must fail INVALID_STATE
- WorkOrder ESCALATED → RESOLVED transition (currently only UNDER_REVIEW → RESOLVED tested)
- Rider stays ON_DELIVERY when other active assignments remain (merged route partial delivery)
- Solo delivery has no merge discount even when route_group_id is set but group has only 1 assignment

## Cascade effects unchecked
- Restaurant `pending_settlement_cents` DECREMENT on approved Return
- Waive of ABUSIVE_RETURN fine restores customer's credit_balance_cents
- Waive of RESTAURANT subject fine returns restaurant's pending_settlement
- LATE_DELIVERY fine waive credits rider wallet back (only no-show waive tested)
- Abusive return fine combined with order's payment_status PARTIALLY_REFUNDED vs FULLY_REFUNDED
- Order's `actual_delivery_time`/`minutes_late` are null pre-delivery (placement, accept, picked-up states)
- `final_delivery_fee_cents`/`final_commission_cents` null pre-delivery

## Validation pipeline priority
- Priority 3 left-to-right NOT_FOUND on nested path (e.g. `/restaurants/{good}/menu-items/{bad}` returns NOT_FOUND on second id, vs `/restaurants/{bad}/...`)
- Priority 7 RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE fires BEFORE state-machine precondition
- Priority 12 OCC fires LAST (after all other validation), tested via stale version on otherwise-invalid request
- Priority 4 FK body NOT_FOUND on unknown customer_id, rider_id in body

## RBAC gaps
- PlatformAdmin reading any customer/rider/assignment (positive coverage)
- Rider reading another rider's Assignment → ERR_FORBIDDEN
- Customer querying fines with mismatched subject_id → ERR_FORBIDDEN
- Restaurant querying own fines (subject_type=RESTAURANT path)
- CS/Admin querying any subject's fines without subject_id filter

## Pagination & misc
- `limit=1` boundary
- Very high `offset` past total_count returns empty data with has_more=false
- Pagination on /orders, /fines, /work-orders (only /restaurants tested)
- WO related_return_id gating when return is REQUESTED (not just ESCALATED) — both should block resolve
- WorkOrder submit-info opener `X-User-ID` mismatch → ERR_FORBIDDEN
- RESTAURANT_STOCKOUT fine reason (never created/tested anywhere)
- Route-merge discount math: floor(solo_fee * 0.25) for merged 2+ assignment group, verify discount on rider fee
- Concurrent rider accept (two simultaneous in same request batch) producing exactly one ACCEPTED
- Order placement when customer has positive credit_balance_cents (drawdown before card charge)

"""More self-tests — covering boundary cases and remaining PRD rules."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)

from tests.harness import TestClient, TestRunner

NYC = (40.7128, -74.0060)
NEAR_NYC = (40.7129, -74.0061)
FAR_NYC = (40.7228, -74.0060)
VERY_FAR_NYC = (41.0000, -73.5000)  # ~62km away — high fee bands

CLIENT = TestClient()
R = TestRunner()


# --- helpers (same as run_tests_extra) ---
def register_active_restaurant(name="R", coords=NYC, commission_override=None):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/restaurants", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                          body={"name": name, "address": "1 a", "lat": coords[0], "lng": coords[1],
                                "commission_rate_override": commission_override})
    rid = b["data"]["id"]
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/restaurants/{rid}/approve",
                   role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    return b["data"]


def register_customer(phone="555", coords=NEAR_NYC):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/customers", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                          body={"name": "C", "phone": phone, "address": "x",
                                "lat": coords[0], "lng": coords[1]})
    return b["data"]


def register_rider(phone="r"):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/riders", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                          body={"name": "R", "phone": phone})
    return b["data"]


def online(rider):
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/riders/{rider['id']}/go-online",
                   role="Rider", user_id=rider["id"])


def add_menu(rid, price=2000, name="X"):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/restaurants/{rid}/menu-items",
                          role="Restaurant", user_id=rid,
                          body={"name": name, "price_cents": price})
    return b["data"]


def place_order(cid, rid, items):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/orders", role="Customer", user_id=cid,
                          body={"customer_id": cid, "restaurant_id": rid, "items": items})
    return b["data"]


def advance(s):
    CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/_clock/advance", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                   body={"seconds": s})


def full_deliver(customer, restaurant, rider, price=2000, qty=1, late_seconds=0):
    m = add_menu(restaurant["id"], price=price)
    o = place_order(customer["id"], restaurant["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m["id"], "quantity": qty}])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/accept",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=restaurant["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/start-preparing",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=restaurant["id"])
    from store import STORE
    aid = next(a["id"] for a in STORE.assignments.values()
                if a["order_id"] == o["id"] and a["status"] == "OFFERED")
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rider["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/ready",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=restaurant["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/pickup", role="Rider", user_id=rider["id"])
    if late_seconds:
        advance(45 * 60 + late_seconds)
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rider["id"])
    return o, aid


# === Late delivery boundaries ===
def t_late_exactly_1():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, late_seconds=60)  # 1 min late
    from store import STORE
    fines = [f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
    assert len(fines) == 1 and fines[0]["amount_cents"] == 200


def t_late_exactly_10():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, late_seconds=10 * 60)
    from store import STORE
    fines = [f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
    assert len(fines) == 1 and fines[0]["amount_cents"] == 200, fines[0]


def t_late_exactly_11():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, late_seconds=11 * 60)
    from store import STORE
    fines = [f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
    # tier 2: 500 + 50*(11-10) = 550
    assert fines[0]["amount_cents"] == 550


def t_late_exactly_30():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, late_seconds=30 * 60)
    from store import STORE
    fines = [f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
    # tier 2 cap: 500 + 50*20 = 1500
    assert fines[0]["amount_cents"] == 1500, fines[0]


def t_late_exactly_31():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, late_seconds=31 * 60)
    from store import STORE
    fines = [f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
    # tier 3: min(final_fee, 1500) + 500 = min(300/500, 1500) + 500
    assert fines[0]["amount_cents"] in (300 + 500, 500 + 500)


def t_late_fee_above_1500_cap():
    """For a long-distance order with final_delivery_fee_cents > 1500, the clawback caps at 1500."""
    CLIENT.reset()
    # 0.7228, -74.006 vs 41.0, -73.5 → far ~ many km. Let's compute: lat diff 0.27..., lng diff 0.5+
    # Use VERY_FAR_NYC as customer
    r = register_active_restaurant(coords=NYC)
    c = register_customer(coords=VERY_FAR_NYC)
    rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, late_seconds=31 * 60)
    from store import STORE
    fines = [f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
    # The final delivery fee for ~62km is large; clawback caps at 1500.
    # fine = 1500 + 500 = 2000
    assert fines[0]["amount_cents"] == 2000, (fines[0], STORE.orders[o["id"]]["final_delivery_fee_cents"])


# === Commission tier boundary ===
def t_commission_at_50000_boundary():
    from pricing import tiered_commission_cents
    # subtotal exactly 50000: 20000*.15 + 30000*.18 = 3000 + 5400 = 8400
    assert tiered_commission_cents(50_000) == 8400
    # subtotal 50001: 20000*.15 + 30000*.18 + 1*.22 = 3000 + 5400 + 0.22 → round half-up to 8404
    # Wait: 0.22 rounds to 0 (half-up). So result is 8400. Let me reconsider.
    # 0.22 → round half-up to integer = 0 (since 0.22 < 0.5)
    # So total = 8400.22 → 8400
    assert tiered_commission_cents(50_001) == 8400


def t_commission_half_up_rounding():
    from pricing import tiered_commission_cents
    # find a subtotal whose tiered total ends in .5: e.g., subtotal 100 → 100*.15 = 15. No fraction.
    # try 13 cents: 13*.15 = 1.95 → 2 (half-up)
    # Wait we need subtotal >= 100. Try 103: 103*.15 = 15.45 → 15
    # try 107: 16.05 → 16 (since .05 < .5, hmm round-half-up at .05 makes 16 only when .05 is treated as >= .5 — no .05 < .5 → 16)
    # Half-up: 16.05 → 16 (because .05 rounds down? no — .05 is less than .5, rounds down)
    # Wait the half-up rule applies to the .5 boundary. So 16.05 → 16 (because .05 < .5), 16.5 → 17.
    # Just verify: subtotal 110, 110*.15 = 16.5 → 17 (half-up)
    assert tiered_commission_cents(110) == 17


# === Trust score boundary ===
def t_trust_score_exact_0_5_no_abusive_fine():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    from store import STORE
    STORE.customers[c["id"]]["trust_score"] = 0.5  # exactly 0.5: NOT strictly less than
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, price=2000)
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/returns",
                          role="Customer", user_id=c["id"],
                          body={"reason": "QUALITY_ISSUE", "requested_refund_cents": 500})
    rid = b["data"]["id"]
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/returns/{rid}/approve",
                   role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1",
                   body={"approved_refund_cents": 500})
    s, fb = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/fines?subject_type=CUSTOMER&subject_id={c['id']}",
                           role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert len(fb["data"]) == 0


def t_abusive_only_on_quality_issue():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    from store import STORE
    STORE.customers[c["id"]]["trust_score"] = 0.3
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, price=2000)
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/returns",
                          role="Customer", user_id=c["id"],
                          body={"reason": "WRONG_ITEM", "requested_refund_cents": 500})
    rid = b["data"]["id"]
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/returns/{rid}/approve",
                   role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1",
                   body={"approved_refund_cents": 500})
    s, fb = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/fines?subject_type=CUSTOMER&subject_id={c['id']}",
                           role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert len(fb["data"]) == 0


# === Restaurant settlement decrement on approved return ===
def t_restaurant_settlement_decrement_on_return():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, price=2000)
    # After delivery, restaurant has 2000 - 300 = 1700 pending.
    s, rest = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/restaurants/{r['id']}",
                             role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert rest["data"]["pending_settlement_cents"] == 1700
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/returns",
                          role="Customer", user_id=c["id"],
                          body={"reason": "OTHER", "requested_refund_cents": 500})
    rid = b["data"]["id"]
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/returns/{rid}/approve",
                   role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1",
                   body={"approved_refund_cents": 500})
    s, rest = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/restaurants/{r['id']}",
                             role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert rest["data"]["pending_settlement_cents"] == 1700 - 500


# === Fine waive variations ===
def t_late_delivery_fine_waive_credits_back():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, price=2000, late_seconds=5 * 60)
    from store import STORE
    fine = next(f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY")
    s, rb = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/riders/{rd['id']}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    wallet_before = rb["data"]["wallet_balance_cents"]
    s, _ = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/fines/{fine['id']}/waive",
                          role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    s, rb2 = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/riders/{rd['id']}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert rb2["data"]["wallet_balance_cents"] == wallet_before + 200


def t_abusive_fine_waive_restores_credit():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    from store import STORE
    STORE.customers[c["id"]]["trust_score"] = 0.3
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, price=2000)
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/returns",
                          role="Customer", user_id=c["id"],
                          body={"reason": "QUALITY_ISSUE", "requested_refund_cents": 500})
    rid = b["data"]["id"]
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/returns/{rid}/approve",
                   role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1",
                   body={"approved_refund_cents": 500})
    # After approval: customer.credit = 500 (refund), then -500 (fine) = 0
    s, cb = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/customers/{c['id']}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert cb["data"]["credit_balance_cents"] == 0
    fine = next(f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "ABUSIVE_RETURN")
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/fines/{fine['id']}/waive",
                   role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    s, cb = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/customers/{c['id']}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert cb["data"]["credit_balance_cents"] == 500


# === Return reopen state ===
def t_return_reopen_only_from_escalated():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, price=2000)
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/returns",
                          role="Customer", user_id=c["id"],
                          body={"reason": "OTHER", "requested_refund_cents": 100})
    rid = b["data"]["id"]
    # Currently REQUESTED — reopen should fail.
    s, _ = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/returns/{rid}/reopen",
                          role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1")
    assert s == 409


# === WorkOrder ===
def t_wo_escalated_then_resolved():
    CLIENT.reset()
    c = register_customer()
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/work-orders", role="Customer", user_id=c["id"],
                          body={"category": "OTHER"})
    wid = b["data"]["id"]
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/work-orders/{wid}/assign",
                   role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1")
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/work-orders/{wid}/escalate",
                   role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1")
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/work-orders/{wid}/resolve",
                          role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1",
                          body={"resolution_notes": "fixed"})
    assert s == 200 and b["data"]["status"] == "RESOLVED"


def t_wo_resolve_blocked_when_return_requested():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, price=2000)
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/returns",
                          role="Customer", user_id=c["id"],
                          body={"reason": "OTHER", "requested_refund_cents": 100})
    rid = b["data"]["id"]
    # Open WO referring to this return without escalating.
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/work-orders", role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1",
                          body={"category": "OTHER", "related_return_id": rid})
    wid = b["data"]["id"]
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/work-orders/{wid}/assign",
                   role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1")
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/work-orders/{wid}/resolve",
                          role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1",
                          body={"resolution_notes": "x"})
    assert s == 422 and b["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_RELATED_RETURN_UNRESOLVED"


def t_wo_submit_info_opener_mismatch():
    CLIENT.reset()
    c1 = register_customer("p1")
    c2 = register_customer("p2")
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/work-orders", role="Customer", user_id=c1["id"],
                          body={"category": "OTHER"})
    wid = b["data"]["id"]
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/work-orders/{wid}/assign",
                   role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1")
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/work-orders/{wid}/request-info",
                   role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1")
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/work-orders/{wid}/submit-info",
                          role="Customer", user_id=c2["id"])
    assert s == 403


# === Solo delivery no merge discount ===
def t_solo_delivery_no_discount():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(coords=NYC)
    c = register_customer(coords=FAR_NYC)
    rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, price=2000)
    s, ob = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}",
                           role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    # distance: ~1.11 km → ceil(1.1) = 2 bands → 300 + 240 = 540 (off-peak) or 740 (peak)
    fee = ob["data"]["final_delivery_fee_cents"]
    assert fee in (540, 740), fee
    # No route_group_id should be set for solo
    s, ab = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/assignments/{aid}",
                           role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert ab["data"]["route_group_id"] is None


# === Route merge: full flow with 2 close orders ===
def t_route_merge_two_orders():
    CLIENT.reset()
    # Two restaurants near each other
    r1 = register_active_restaurant(name="R1", coords=(40.7128, -74.0060))
    r2 = register_active_restaurant(name="R2", coords=(40.7130, -74.0062))  # ~24m away
    c1 = register_customer("p1", coords=(40.7200, -74.0100))
    c2 = register_customer("p2", coords=(40.7210, -74.0110))
    rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    m1 = add_menu(r1["id"], name="A", price=2000)
    m2 = add_menu(r2["id"], name="B", price=2000)

    o1 = place_order(c1["id"], r1["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m1["id"], "quantity": 1}])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o1['id']}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=r1["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o1['id']}/start-preparing",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=r1["id"])
    from store import STORE
    aid1 = next(a["id"] for a in STORE.assignments.values() if a["order_id"] == o1["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid1}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])

    # Now rider is ON_DELIVERY. Place a second order for r2 (within 500m of r1).
    o2 = place_order(c2["id"], r2["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m2["id"], "quantity": 1}])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o2['id']}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=r2["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o2['id']}/start-preparing",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=r2["id"])
    # Rider should be candidate (the only one)
    aid2 = next(a["id"] for a in STORE.assignments.values() if a["order_id"] == o2["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid2}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    # After accept, route group should exist with both assignments.
    a2 = STORE.assignments[aid2]
    assert a2["route_group_id"] is not None
    group = STORE.route_groups[a2["route_group_id"]]
    assert len(group["assignment_ids"]) == 2

    # Ready + pickup + deliver both.
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o1['id']}/ready", role="Restaurant", user_id=r1["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid1}/pickup", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o2['id']}/ready", role="Restaurant", user_id=r2["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid2}/pickup", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid1}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    # After first delivery, rider still ON_DELIVERY
    s, rb = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/riders/{rd['id']}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert rb["data"]["status"] == "ON_DELIVERY"
    # Verify merged fee: solo fee for o1 distance ~ 0.95km → 2 bands → 540; discount = floor(540*0.25) = 135
    s, ob1 = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/orders/{o1['id']}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    solo = ob1["data"]["final_delivery_fee_cents"] + 135  # may vary if peak; pick safe approach
    # Just verify discount applies: assignment.final_delivery_fee_cents < solo.
    s, ab1 = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/assignments/{aid1}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    from pricing import solo_delivery_fee_cents
    expected_solo = solo_delivery_fee_cents(STORE.orders[o1["id"]]["distance_km"],
                                              STORE.orders[o1["id"]]["is_peak"])
    expected_discount = int(expected_solo * 0.25)  # floor
    assert ab1["data"]["final_delivery_fee_cents"] == expected_solo - expected_discount

    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid2}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    # Now route group COMPLETED, rider AVAILABLE.
    s, rb = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/riders/{rd['id']}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert rb["data"]["status"] == "AVAILABLE"
    assert STORE.route_groups[group["id"]]["status"] == "COMPLETED"


# === Priority pipeline ===
def t_priority_fk_body_not_found():
    """Priority 4: unknown customer_id in body returns NOT_FOUND."""
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant()
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/orders", role="Customer", user_id="unknown",
                          body={"customer_id": "unknown", "restaurant_id": r["id"],
                                "items": [{"menu_item_id": "x", "quantity": 1}]})
    assert s == 404


def t_priority_restaurant_unavailable_before_state():
    """Priority 7 (RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE) fires before priority 6 (state) — but only when state passes."""
    CLIENT.reset()
    # Have an active restaurant that gets suspended → its order becomes CANCELLED.
    # Then try to accept again — order is CANCELLED, restaurant is SUSPENDED. State fail first.
    r = register_active_restaurant()
    c = register_customer()
    m = add_menu(r["id"])
    o = place_order(c["id"], r["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m["id"], "quantity": 1}])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/restaurants/{r['id']}/suspend",
                   role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    # Now order is CANCELLED. Restaurant SUSPENDED. Accept should fail state (priority 6) first.
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/accept",
                          role="Restaurant", user_id=r["id"])
    assert s == 409 and b["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_INVALID_STATE"


def t_occ_only_when_version_supplied():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant()
    # No version supplied → no OCC check
    s, _ = CLIENT.request("PATCH", f"/api/restaurants/{r['id']}",
                          role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                          body={"address": "new"})
    assert s == 200
    # Wrong version supplied → 409
    s, b = CLIENT.request("PATCH", f"/api/restaurants/{r['id']}",
                          role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                          body={"address": "newer", "version": 999})
    assert s == 409 and b["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_VERSION_CONFLICT"


# === Concurrent races ===
def t_two_returns_race_first_wins():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, price=2000)
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/returns",
                          role="Customer", user_id=c["id"],
                          body={"reason": "OTHER", "requested_refund_cents": 100})
    rid = b["data"]["id"]
    # First approve.
    s, _ = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/returns/{rid}/approve",
                          role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1",
                          body={"approved_refund_cents": 100})
    assert s == 200
    # Second approve attempt — return is now APPROVED, not REQUESTED/ESCALATED → ERR_INVALID_STATE
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/returns/{rid}/approve",
                          role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-2",
                          body={"approved_refund_cents": 100})
    assert s == 409 and b["data"]["error_id"] == "ERR_INVALID_STATE"


def t_restaurant_settle_audit_marker():
    """Two settle calls in a row — second one just zeros the (already zero) balance."""
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant()
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/restaurants/{r['id']}/settle",
                   role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/restaurants/{r['id']}/settle",
                          role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert s == 200 and b["data"]["pending_settlement_cents"] == 0


# === RBAC ===
def t_rider_reads_only_own_record():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r1 = register_rider("p1")
    r2 = register_rider("p2")
    s, _ = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/riders/{r1['id']}",
                          role="Rider", user_id=r2["id"])
    assert s == 403
    s, _ = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/riders/{r1['id']}",
                          role="Rider", user_id=r1["id"])
    assert s == 200


def t_rider_reads_only_own_assignment():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer()
    r1 = register_rider("p1"); online(r1)
    r2 = register_rider("p2"); online(r2)
    m = add_menu(r["id"])
    o = place_order(c["id"], r["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m["id"], "quantity": 1}])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=r["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/start-preparing",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=r["id"])
    from store import STORE
    aid = next(a["id"] for a in STORE.assignments.values() if a["order_id"] == o["id"])
    owner = STORE.assignments[aid]["rider_id"]
    other = r1["id"] if owner == r2["id"] else r2["id"]
    s, _ = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/assignments/{aid}",
                          role="Rider", user_id=other)
    assert s == 403


# === Cancellation voids payment ===
def t_cancel_voids_payment():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant()
    c = register_customer()
    m = add_menu(r["id"])
    o = place_order(c["id"], r["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m["id"], "quantity": 1}])
    assert o["payment_status"] == "AUTHORIZED"
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/cancel",
                          role="Customer", user_id=c["id"])
    assert s == 200
    assert b["data"]["payment_status"] == "VOIDED"


# === Pagination edges ===
def t_pagination_limit_1():
    CLIENT.reset()
    for i in range(5):
        CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/restaurants", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                       body={"name": f"R{i}", "address": "a", "lat": 0, "lng": 0})
    s, b = CLIENT.request("GET", "/api/restaurants?limit=1&offset=2",
                          role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert s == 200 and len(b["data"]) == 1
    assert b["meta"]["has_more"] is True


def t_pagination_offset_past_total():
    CLIENT.reset()
    CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/restaurants", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                   body={"name": "X", "address": "a", "lat": 0, "lng": 0})
    s, b = CLIENT.request("GET", "/api/restaurants?offset=100",
                          role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert s == 200 and len(b["data"]) == 0
    assert b["meta"]["has_more"] is False


# === Pre-delivery fields are null ===
def t_pre_delivery_fields_null():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    m = add_menu(r["id"])
    o = place_order(c["id"], r["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m["id"], "quantity": 1}])
    assert o["actual_delivery_time"] is None
    assert o["minutes_late"] is None
    assert o["final_delivery_fee_cents"] is None
    assert o["final_commission_cents"] is None


# === Clock sweep redispatch ===
def t_clock_sweep_creates_fresh_offer():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer()
    r1 = register_rider("p1"); online(r1)
    r2 = register_rider("p2"); online(r2)
    m = add_menu(r["id"])
    o = place_order(c["id"], r["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m["id"], "quantity": 1}])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=r["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/start-preparing",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=r["id"])
    from store import STORE
    pre_count = sum(1 for a in STORE.assignments.values() if a["order_id"] == o["id"])
    assert pre_count == 1
    # First rider was offered. Timeout sweep.
    advance(61)
    # Should have made a new OFFERED to the other rider.
    statuses = [a["status"] for a in STORE.assignments.values() if a["order_id"] == o["id"]]
    assert statuses.count("REJECTED") == 1
    assert "OFFERED" in statuses


# === Order placement with credit drawdown semantic NOT REQUIRED to mutate credit ===
def t_credit_balance_unaffected_by_placement_and_cancel():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer()
    # Manually set credit to nonzero
    from store import STORE
    STORE.customers[c["id"]]["credit_balance_cents"] = 1000
    m = add_menu(r["id"])
    o = place_order(c["id"], r["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m["id"], "quantity": 1}])
    s, cb = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/customers/{c['id']}",
                           role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    # PRD §3.5 says credit_balance_cents is not affected on cancellation.
    # We don't decrement it on placement either — leave it alone unless PRD-specified mutations occur.
    s, _ = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/cancel",
                          role="Customer", user_id=c["id"])
    s, cb2 = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/customers/{c['id']}",
                            role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert cb2["data"]["credit_balance_cents"] == 1000


TESTS = [
    ("late exactly 1 min fine 200", t_late_exactly_1),
    ("late exactly 10 min fine 200", t_late_exactly_10),
    ("late exactly 11 min fine 550", t_late_exactly_11),
    ("late exactly 30 min fine 1500", t_late_exactly_30),
    ("late exactly 31 min tier 3", t_late_exactly_31),
    ("late fee above 1500 caps at 1500", t_late_fee_above_1500_cap),
    ("commission tier 50000 boundary", t_commission_at_50000_boundary),
    ("commission half-up rounding", t_commission_half_up_rounding),
    ("trust score exactly 0.5 — no fine", t_trust_score_exact_0_5_no_abusive_fine),
    ("abusive fine only on QUALITY_ISSUE", t_abusive_only_on_quality_issue),
    ("restaurant pending settlement decrement on return", t_restaurant_settlement_decrement_on_return),
    ("LATE_DELIVERY fine waive credits rider back", t_late_delivery_fine_waive_credits_back),
    ("ABUSIVE_RETURN fine waive restores credit", t_abusive_fine_waive_restores_credit),
    ("return reopen only from ESCALATED", t_return_reopen_only_from_escalated),
    ("WO ESCALATED → RESOLVED", t_wo_escalated_then_resolved),
    ("WO resolve blocked when return REQUESTED", t_wo_resolve_blocked_when_return_requested),
    ("WO submit_info opener_id mismatch", t_wo_submit_info_opener_mismatch),
    ("solo delivery no discount", t_solo_delivery_no_discount),
    ("two-order route merge complete + AVAILABLE", t_route_merge_two_orders),
    ("priority — FK body not found", t_priority_fk_body_not_found),
    ("priority — state before domain on cancelled+suspended", t_priority_restaurant_unavailable_before_state),
    ("OCC only when version supplied", t_occ_only_when_version_supplied),
    ("second approve loser → INVALID_STATE", t_two_returns_race_first_wins),
    ("idempotent settle returns zero", t_restaurant_settle_audit_marker),
    ("rider reads only own record", t_rider_reads_only_own_record),
    ("rider reads only own assignment", t_rider_reads_only_own_assignment),
    ("cancellation voids payment", t_cancel_voids_payment),
    ("pagination limit=1", t_pagination_limit_1),
    ("pagination offset past total", t_pagination_offset_past_total),
    ("pre-delivery fields null", t_pre_delivery_fields_null),
    ("clock sweep creates fresh offer", t_clock_sweep_creates_fresh_offer),
    ("credit_balance unaffected by placement/cancel", t_credit_balance_unaffected_by_placement_and_cancel),
]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for name, fn in TESTS:
        R.run(name, fn)
    ok = R.report()
    sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

"""More self-tests — covering boundary cases and remaining PRD rules."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(HERE)
sys.path.insert(0, ROOT)

from tests.harness import TestClient, TestRunner

NYC = (40.7128, -74.0060)
NEAR_NYC = (40.7129, -74.0061)
FAR_NYC = (40.7228, -74.0060)
VERY_FAR_NYC = (41.0000, -73.5000)  # ~62km away — high fee bands

CLIENT = TestClient()
R = TestRunner()


# --- helpers (same as run_tests_extra) ---
def register_active_restaurant(name="R", coords=NYC, commission_override=None):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/restaurants", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                          body={"name": name, "address": "1 a", "lat": coords[0], "lng": coords[1],
                                "commission_rate_override": commission_override})
    rid = b["data"]["id"]
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/restaurants/{rid}/approve",
                   role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    return b["data"]


def register_customer(phone="555", coords=NEAR_NYC):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/customers", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                          body={"name": "C", "phone": phone, "address": "x",
                                "lat": coords[0], "lng": coords[1]})
    return b["data"]


def register_rider(phone="r"):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/riders", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                          body={"name": "R", "phone": phone})
    return b["data"]


def online(rider):
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/riders/{rider['id']}/go-online",
                   role="Rider", user_id=rider["id"])


def add_menu(rid, price=2000, name="X"):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/restaurants/{rid}/menu-items",
                          role="Restaurant", user_id=rid,
                          body={"name": name, "price_cents": price})
    return b["data"]


def place_order(cid, rid, items):
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/orders", role="Customer", user_id=cid,
                          body={"customer_id": cid, "restaurant_id": rid, "items": items})
    return b["data"]


def advance(s):
    CLIENT.request("POST", "/api/_clock/advance", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin",
                   body={"seconds": s})


def full_deliver(customer, restaurant, rider, price=2000, qty=1, late_seconds=0):
    m = add_menu(restaurant["id"], price=price)
    o = place_order(customer["id"], restaurant["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m["id"], "quantity": qty}])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/accept",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=restaurant["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/start-preparing",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=restaurant["id"])
    from store import STORE
    aid = next(a["id"] for a in STORE.assignments.values()
                if a["order_id"] == o["id"] and a["status"] == "OFFERED")
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rider["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/ready",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=restaurant["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/pickup", role="Rider", user_id=rider["id"])
    if late_seconds:
        advance(45 * 60 + late_seconds)
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rider["id"])
    return o, aid


# === Late delivery boundaries ===
def t_late_exactly_1():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, late_seconds=60)  # 1 min late
    from store import STORE
    fines = [f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
    assert len(fines) == 1 and fines[0]["amount_cents"] == 200


def t_late_exactly_10():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, late_seconds=10 * 60)
    from store import STORE
    fines = [f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
    assert len(fines) == 1 and fines[0]["amount_cents"] == 200, fines[0]


def t_late_exactly_11():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, late_seconds=11 * 60)
    from store import STORE
    fines = [f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
    # tier 2: 500 + 50*(11-10) = 550
    assert fines[0]["amount_cents"] == 550


def t_late_exactly_30():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, late_seconds=30 * 60)
    from store import STORE
    fines = [f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
    # tier 2 cap: 500 + 50*20 = 1500
    assert fines[0]["amount_cents"] == 1500, fines[0]


def t_late_exactly_31():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, late_seconds=31 * 60)
    from store import STORE
    fines = [f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
    # tier 3: min(final_fee, 1500) + 500 = min(300/500, 1500) + 500
    assert fines[0]["amount_cents"] in (300 + 500, 500 + 500)


def t_late_fee_above_1500_cap():
    """For a long-distance order with final_delivery_fee_cents > 1500, the clawback caps at 1500."""
    CLIENT.reset()
    # 0.7228, -74.006 vs 41.0, -73.5 → far ~ many km. Let's compute: lat diff 0.27..., lng diff 0.5+
    # Use VERY_FAR_NYC as customer
    r = register_active_restaurant(coords=NYC)
    c = register_customer(coords=VERY_FAR_NYC)
    rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, late_seconds=31 * 60)
    from store import STORE
    fines = [f for f in STORE.fines.values() if f["reason"] == "LATE_DELIVERY"]
    # The final delivery fee for ~62km is large; clawback caps at 1500.
    # fine = 1500 + 500 = 2000
    assert fines[0]["amount_cents"] == 2000, (fines[0], STORE.orders[o["id"]]["final_delivery_fee_cents"])


# === Commission tier boundary ===
def t_commission_at_50000_boundary():
    from pricing import tiered_commission_cents
    # subtotal exactly 50000: 20000*.15 + 30000*.18 = 3000 + 5400 = 8400
    assert tiered_commission_cents(50_000) == 8400
    # subtotal 50001: 20000*.15 + 30000*.18 + 1*.22 = 3000 + 5400 + 0.22 → round half-up to 8404
    # Wait: 0.22 rounds to 0 (half-up). So result is 8400. Let me reconsider.
    # 0.22 → round half-up to integer = 0 (since 0.22 < 0.5)
    # So total = 8400.22 → 8400
    assert tiered_commission_cents(50_001) == 8400


def t_commission_half_up_rounding():
    from pricing import tiered_commission_cents
    # find a subtotal whose tiered total ends in .5: e.g., subtotal 100 → 100*.15 = 15. No fraction.
    # try 13 cents: 13*.15 = 1.95 → 2 (half-up)
    # Wait we need subtotal >= 100. Try 103: 103*.15 = 15.45 → 15
    # try 107: 16.05 → 16 (since .05 < .5, hmm round-half-up at .05 makes 16 only when .05 is treated as >= .5 — no .05 < .5 → 16)
    # Half-up: 16.05 → 16 (because .05 rounds down? no — .05 is less than .5, rounds down)
    # Wait the half-up rule applies to the .5 boundary. So 16.05 → 16 (because .05 < .5), 16.5 → 17.
    # Just verify: subtotal 110, 110*.15 = 16.5 → 17 (half-up)
    assert tiered_commission_cents(110) == 17


# === Trust score boundary ===
def t_trust_score_exact_0_5_no_abusive_fine():
    CLIENT.reset()
    r = register_active_restaurant(); c = register_customer(); rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    from store import STORE
    STORE.customers[c["id"]]["trust_score"] = 0.5  # exactly 0.5: NOT strictly less than
    o, aid = full_deliver(c, r, rd, price=2000)
    s, b = CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o['id']}/returns",
                          role="Customer", user_id=c["id"],
                          body={"reason": "QUALITY_ISSUE", "requested_refund_cents": 500})
    rid = b["data"]["id"]
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/returns/{rid}/approve",
                   role="CustomerService", user_id="cs-1",
                   body={"approved_refund_cents": 500})

# === Route merge: full flow with 2 close orders ===
def t_route_merge_two_orders():
    CLIENT.reset()
    # Two restaurants near each other
    r1 = register_active_restaurant(name="R1", coords=(40.7128, -74.0060))
    r2 = register_active_restaurant(name="R2", coords=(40.7130, -74.0062))  # ~24m away
    c1 = register_customer("p1", coords=(40.7200, -74.0100))
    c2 = register_customer("p2", coords=(40.7210, -74.0110))
    rd = register_rider(); online(rd)
    m1 = add_menu(r1["id"], name="A", price=2000)
    m2 = add_menu(r2["id"], name="B", price=2000)

    o1 = place_order(c1["id"], r1["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m1["id"], "quantity": 1}])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o1['id']}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=r1["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o1['id']}/start-preparing",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=r1["id"])
    from store import STORE
    aid1 = next(a["id"] for a in STORE.assignments.values() if a["order_id"] == o1["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid1}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])

    # Now rider is ON_DELIVERY. Place a second order for r2 (within 500m of r1).
    o2 = place_order(c2["id"], r2["id"], [{"menu_item_id": m2["id"], "quantity": 1}])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o2['id']}/accept", role="Restaurant", user_id=r2["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o2['id']}/start-preparing",
                   role="Restaurant", user_id=r2["id"])
    # Rider should be candidate (the only one)
    aid2 = next(a["id"] for a in STORE.assignments.values() if a["order_id"] == o2["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid2}/accept", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    # After accept, route group should exist with both assignments.
    a2 = STORE.assignments[aid2]
    assert a2["route_group_id"] is not None
    group = STORE.route_groups[a2["route_group_id"]]
    assert len(group["assignment_ids"]) == 2

    # Ready + pickup + deliver both.
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o1['id']}/ready", role="Restaurant", user_id=r1["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid1}/pickup", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/orders/{o2['id']}/ready", role="Restaurant", user_id=r2["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid2}/pickup", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid1}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    # After first delivery, rider still ON_DELIVERY
    s, rb = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/riders/{rd['id']}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert rb["data"]["status"] == "ON_DELIVERY"
    # Verify merged fee: solo fee for o1 distance ~ 0.95km → 2 bands → 540; discount = floor(540*0.25) = 135
    s, ob1 = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/orders/{o1['id']}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    solo = ob1["data"]["final_delivery_fee_cents"] + 135  # may vary if peak; pick safe approach
    # Just verify discount applies: assignment.final_delivery_fee_cents < solo.
    s, ab1 = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/assignments/{aid1}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    from pricing import solo_delivery_fee_cents
    expected_solo = solo_delivery_fee_cents(STORE.orders[o1["id"]]["distance_km"],
                                              STORE.orders[o1["id"]]["is_peak"])
    expected_discount = int(expected_solo * 0.25)  # floor
    assert ab1["data"]["final_delivery_fee_cents"] == expected_solo - expected_discount

    CLIENT.request("POST", f"/api/assignments/{aid2}/deliver", role="Rider", user_id=rd["id"])
    # Now route group COMPLETED, rider AVAILABLE.
    s, rb = CLIENT.request("GET", f"/api/riders/{rd['id']}", role="PlatformAdmin", user_id="admin")
    assert rb["data"]["status"] == "AVAILABLE"
    assert STORE.route_groups[group["id"]]["status"] == "COMPLETED"

    assert statuses.count("REJECTED") == 1

199:Route merging happens at the same moment. When the accepting rider already holds an `ACTIVE` `RouteGroup` and the newly accepted order's pickup restaurant is within 500 metres of an existing unpicked assignment's pickup restaurant, the new assignment is attached to that `RouteGroup` — its `route_group_id` is set to the group's `id` and the group's `assignment_ids` array is extended to include the new assignment's `id`. The `RouteGroup` itself tracks its own `rider_id`, `assignment_ids`, `merged_at` timestamp, and `status`, which spans `ACTIVE`, `COMPLETED`, and `ABANDONED`, starting in `ACTIVE`. Solo deliveries leave `route_group_id` null.
237:A `CustomerService` operator then reviews. Approval carries an `approved_refund_cents` amount that must be at least 1, at most the order's `subtotal_cents`, and at most the originally requested refund — any violation is rejected with `ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID`. On approval, the `Return` moves to `APPROVED` and the owning order cascades from `REFUND_REQUESTED` to `REFUNDED`. The order's `payment_status` becomes `PARTIALLY_REFUNDED` if `approved_refund_cents` is strictly less than `subtotal_cents`, or `FULLY_REFUNDED` if the approved amount equals the subtotal. The customer's `credit_balance_cents` is credited by `approved_refund_cents`. The restaurant's `pending_settlement_cents` is decremented by the same amount. And finally, if the customer's `trust_score` is strictly below 0.5 and the return's `reason` is `QUALITY_ISSUE`, a `Fine` is created whose subject is the customer and whose `reason` is `ABUSIVE_RETURN` with `amount_cents` equal to `approved_refund_cents`. The four possible `Fine.reason` values are `LATE_DELIVERY`, `ABUSIVE_RETURN`, `RESTAURANT_STOCKOUT`, and `RIDER_NO_SHOW`; a fine's `subject_type` is one of `RIDER`, `RESTAURANT`, or `CUSTOMER` and its `subject_id` is the matching entity's `id`. A fine's `settlement_status` begins at `PENDING` and can move to `SETTLED` (when the underlying wallet or settlement event has cleared the balance) or `WAIVED` (when a `CustomerService` operator or `PlatformAdmin` forgives the debit and reverses any wallet or credit adjustment).
251:Every fine — whether it originated from a late delivery, a no-show assignment cancellation, an abusive return, or a restaurant stockout (the `RESTAURANT_STOCKOUT` reason) — is queryable by filtering on `subject_type`, `subject_id`, and `settlement_status`. A `Rider`, `Restaurant`, or `Customer` may query only their own fines; their `X-User-ID` must match the `subject_id` filter. `CustomerService` and `PlatformAdmin` may query any subject.

15:Every request to the API must carry two HTTP headers: `X-User-ID`, which identifies the acting user, and `X-User-Role`, which declares the capacity in which they are acting. The platform recognizes five roles, spelled exactly as follows: `Customer`, `Restaurant`, `Rider`, `CustomerService`, and `PlatformAdmin`. A request missing either header, or carrying an `X-User-Role` outside this set, is rejected with `ERR_AUTH_REQUIRED`. A request whose role is recognized but not permitted for the called endpoint is rejected with `ERR_FORBIDDEN`.
19:When `X-User-Role` is `CustomerService`, `X-User-ID` is an opaque operator identifier not tied to any persisted entity; the server may record it — for example, on a `Return` as `reviewer_cs_user_id` when a CS operator approves or rejects, or on a `WorkOrder` as `assigned_cs_user_id` when a CS operator claims the ticket — but it is never compared against the `id` of any entity. The same rule applies when `X-User-Role` is `PlatformAdmin`: the admin's `X-User-ID` is opaque, may be recorded on downstream artifacts as a historical marker, and is never compared to an entity `id`.
21:Identity mismatch — a caller whose role is correct but whose `X-User-ID` does not match the resource the operation targets (for instance, a `Customer` reading another customer's profile, or a `Rider` calling the go-online capability on someone else's rider record) — is rejected with `ERR_FORBIDDEN`.
76:List endpoints accept two query parameters that control windowing. The `limit` parameter specifies the maximum number of items to return; it defaults to 10 when omitted, with a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 100. The `offset` parameter specifies the number of items to skip and defaults to 0. Values outside these ranges are rejected as invalid input.
97:Besides OCC on `version`, the platform enforces several uniqueness-based serializations that surface as conflict errors on the losers. Two riders attempting to accept the same dispatched order concurrently will see exactly one reach `ACCEPTED`; the second attempt is rejected with `ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED`. Two CS operators attempting to approve and reject the same `Return` concurrently will see exactly one decision persist; the losing attempt — whose precondition `Return.status == REQUESTED OR ESCALATED` no longer holds — is rejected with `ERR_INVALID_STATE`. A customer who attempts to open a second `Return` on an order while a first `Return` is already in `REQUESTED`, `APPROVED`, or `ESCALATED` is rejected with `ERR_DUPLICATE_RETURN`. When a restaurant's acceptance of an order races with the customer's cancellation, first-writer-wins on the order's `status` decides the outcome, and the loser — whose precondition that the order still be in `PLACED` is now violated — receives `ERR_INVALID_STATE`.
106:4. Existence of every foreign-key id inside the request body — `customer_id`, `restaurant_id`, `rider_id`, and each `menu_item_id` inside `items` (`ERR_NOT_FOUND`).
119:When an endpoint path embeds multiple identifiers, the system validates each identifier left-to-right and rejects the request at the first one that does not resolve. A request for a menu item under a restaurant that does not exist, for instance, yields `ERR_NOT_FOUND` on the restaurant before the menu item is examined. This ordering also applies to action endpoints: the parent `Order` is resolved before the `Return` beneath it, and the `Return` before any work-order linkage it carries.
165:A `PlatformAdmin` may suspend an `AVAILABLE` rider, but only when at least one of two performance thresholds is breached: the rider's `on_time_rate` must be strictly below 0.70, or the rider's `acceptance_rate` must be strictly below 0.50. Attempting to suspend a rider whose metrics are both at or above these thresholds is rejected with `ERR_SUSPEND_CRITERIA_NOT_MET`. `SUSPENDED` is terminal.
173:An order begins with a `Customer` issuing a placement request carrying three fields: the customer's own `customer_id`, the target `restaurant_id`, and an `items` array. Each entry in `items` specifies a `menu_item_id`, a snapshot `name` taken from the menu item at placement, a `unit_price_cents` pinned from the same snapshot, and a `quantity` of 1 or more. `items` must be non-empty. The order fails placement with `ERR_ORDER_INVALID` when `items` is empty, any quantity is below 1, or the resulting subtotal would be below 100 cents (the minimum order size). The target `Restaurant` must be `ACTIVE` and every `MenuItem` referenced must carry `is_listed` true and match the `Order.restaurant_id` — otherwise placement is rejected with `ERR_RESTAURANT_UNAVAILABLE`.
187:Either the customer or the restaurant (via rejection) may cancel an order while it is still in `PLACED`; the cancellation transitions the order to `CANCELLED` and moves `payment_status` from whichever of `UNPAID` or `AUTHORIZED` it is currently in to `VOIDED`. No charge has captured, so `credit_balance_cents` is not affected. `CustomerService` may also cancel on behalf of a customer. Cancellation once the order has moved beyond `PLACED` is not available through this channel; disputes at later stages flow through the refund workflow in §3.9.
195:The candidate `rider_id` is selected deterministically from the pool of riders whose `status` is `AVAILABLE` or `ON_DELIVERY`. Any rider currently linked to an `OFFERED`, `ACCEPTED`, or `PICKED_UP` `Assignment` for the same `order_id` is excluded from this pool up front — the system never re-offers an order to a rider who already holds it, regardless of whether the offer originated from `/start-preparing`, from an explicit `/dispatch`, or from the fresh offer the system issues after a rejection or cancellation. From the surviving candidates the system prefers any rider in `ON_DELIVERY` whose existing `ACTIVE` `RouteGroup` already contains at least one unpicked assignment whose pickup restaurant is within 500 metres of the new order's pickup restaurant — these are precisely the riders for whom acceptance would trigger the route-merge rule described two paragraphs below — over any rider in `AVAILABLE`. Within either preference tier the tie-breaker is `Rider.created_at` descending, so that the most recently registered rider wins; should that still tie, the rider whose `id` sorts lexicographically smallest is chosen. The presence of other live `Assignment` rows for the same `order_id` — including one already in `ACCEPTED` or `PICKED_UP` — is not by itself grounds for refusal; `/dispatch` always creates a new `OFFERED` `Assignment` so long as the pool is non-empty, and the uniqueness constraint stated in the next paragraph fires later at `/accept` time rather than at dispatch time. The dispatch is refused with `409 ERR_INVALID_STATE` only when the resulting candidate pool is empty, in which case no new `Assignment` is created.
197:Acceptance by a rider requires that the rider's current `status` be `AVAILABLE` or `ON_DELIVERY` (the latter is what enables route merging), that the corresponding `Order.status` be `RESTAURANT_ACCEPTED`, `PREPARING`, or `READY_FOR_PICKUP`, and — critically — that no other `Assignment` already exists for the same `order_id` in `OFFERED`, `ACCEPTED`, or `PICKED_UP`. When two riders race to accept the same dispatched offer, first-writer-wins on this uniqueness constraint: exactly one assignment advances to `ACCEPTED`, and the losing attempt is rejected with `ERR_ORDER_ALREADY_ASSIGNED`. Acceptance stamps `accepted_at`, cascades the rider's `status` to `ON_DELIVERY` if they were `AVAILABLE`, and triggers a recomputation of `acceptance_rate` over the rider's last 30 offers.
233:A customer may open a return on a delivered order. The customer-facing payload carries the return's `reason` — one of `QUALITY_ISSUE`, `WRONG_ITEM`, `LATE`, or `OTHER` — and a `requested_refund_cents` amount. The request is only eligible when the order is in `DELIVERED` and the current moment is within 24 hours of the order's `actual_delivery_time`; requests outside that window are rejected with `ERR_RETURN_WINDOW_EXPIRED`. The requested refund must be at least 1 and at most the order's `subtotal_cents`; values out of range are rejected with `ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID`. A duplicate return attempt — a request made while another `Return` for the same order is already in `REQUESTED`, `APPROVED`, or `ESCALATED` — is rejected with `ERR_DUPLICATE_RETURN`.
237:A `CustomerService` operator then reviews. Approval carries an `approved_refund_cents` amount that must be at least 1, at most the order's `subtotal_cents`, and at most the originally requested refund — any violation is rejected with `ERR_REFUND_AMOUNT_INVALID`. On approval, the `Return` moves to `APPROVED` and the owning order cascades from `REFUND_REQUESTED` to `REFUNDED`. The order's `payment_status` becomes `PARTIALLY_REFUNDED` if `approved_refund_cents` is strictly less than `subtotal_cents`, or `FULLY_REFUNDED` if the approved amount equals the subtotal. The customer's `credit_balance_cents` is credited by `approved_refund_cents`. The restaurant's `pending_settlement_cents` is decremented by the same amount. And finally, if the customer's `trust_score` is strictly below 0.5 and the return's `reason` is `QUALITY_ISSUE`, a `Fine` is created whose subject is the customer and whose `reason` is `ABUSIVE_RETURN` with `amount_cents` equal to `approved_refund_cents`. The four possible `Fine.reason` values are `LATE_DELIVERY`, `ABUSIVE_RETURN`, `RESTAURANT_STOCKOUT`, and `RIDER_NO_SHOW`; a fine's `subject_type` is one of `RIDER`, `RESTAURANT`, or `CUSTOMER` and its `subject_id` is the matching entity's `id`. A fine's `settlement_status` begins at `PENDING` and can move to `SETTLED` (when the underlying wallet or settlement event has cleared the balance) or `WAIVED` (when a `CustomerService` operator or `PlatformAdmin` forgives the debit and reverses any wallet or credit adjustment).
239:Rejection by a `CustomerService` operator moves the `Return` to `REJECTED` and reverts the order from `REFUND_REQUESTED` to `DELIVERED` with no monetary change. Escalation moves the `Return` from `REQUESTED` to `ESCALATED` and opens a `WorkOrder` linked via `related_return_id` for supervisor attention. An escalated return can be brought back to `REQUESTED` through a reopen step — this closes the linked `WorkOrder`. The approve / reject transitions accept both `REQUESTED` and `ESCALATED` as legal starting states; the reopen transition is only legal from `ESCALATED`.
245:The ticket opens in `OPEN`. A `CustomerService` operator (or `PlatformAdmin`) claims the ticket, recording `assigned_cs_user_id` as the caller and transitioning the ticket to `UNDER_REVIEW`. From `UNDER_REVIEW`, the operator can request additional information from the opener — the ticket advances to `AWAITING_INFO` — and the opener (a `Customer`, `Rider`, or `Restaurant`) responds by submitting info, which cycles the ticket back to `UNDER_REVIEW`. When the opener acts, their `X-User-ID` must match `opened_by_id`. From `UNDER_REVIEW` the operator may either escalate the ticket (`UNDER_REVIEW → ESCALATED`) or resolve it (`UNDER_REVIEW → RESOLVED`), and from `ESCALATED` the operator may resolve it as well (`ESCALATED → RESOLVED`). Resolving a ticket requires that `assigned_cs_user_id` be non-null, and — critically — if `related_return_id` is set, the linked `Return`'s `status` must be in `APPROVED` or `REJECTED` before the ticket can move to `RESOLVED`; attempting to resolve while the linked return is still `REQUESTED` or `ESCALATED` is rejected with `ERR_RELATED_RETURN_UNRESOLVED`. Resolution is the moment the operator records `resolution_notes`. From `RESOLVED` the ticket is closed (`RESOLVED → CLOSED`), which is terminal.
251:Every fine — whether it originated from a late delivery, a no-show assignment cancellation, an abusive return, or a restaurant stockout (the `RESTAURANT_STOCKOUT` reason) — is queryable by filtering on `subject_type`, `subject_id`, and `settlement_status`. A `Rider`, `Restaurant`, or `Customer` may query only their own fines; their `X-User-ID` must match the `subject_id` filter. `CustomerService` and `PlatformAdmin` may query any subject.
290:| POST | `/api/assignments/{id}/reject` | Rider rejects a dispatch offer; redispatch is issued | Rider |
296:| POST | `/api/returns/{id}/reject` | CS rejects a return | CustomerService |
